question: Explain the difference between Debouncing and Throttling.
reference_points: debouncing delays execution until a delay passes after last event
throttling limits execution to once every fixed time interval
debouncing use case: search input auto-complete
throttling use case: window scroll or resize events

question: Compare State Management via React Context API vs Redux Toolkit.

Context API can cause unnecessary re-renders in deep trees
Redux Toolkit provides predictable state container and middleware
Redux is better suited for large-scale, complex state trees
